description: Dept. of Elections - Vacating the office of member of the Colombo Municipal Council by Nadil Dhushantha Malagoda
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Colombo Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. The content is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by the Returning Officer, making it directly related to electoral processes and the status of an elected official, which falls under the Elections category.
